text.content:
20 August 2023: the bomb in Arasaka Tower.

When: 20 August 2023
Where: Arasaka Tower, the old Corporate Center
Who was involved: Arasaka and Militech, in the 4th Corporate War
What it changed: The Corporate Center became a crater, Arasaka was thrown out of America, and the Time of the Red began

The 4th Corporate War came home when a nuclear device went off in Arasaka Tower. The Corporate Center became a radioactive crater, the Hot Zone, which stayed that way until 2052; its site is now Corporate Plaza and Memorial Park. Arasaka was thrown out of America and caged in Japan, and Night City spent the rest of the decade burning, starving and shooting itself. A year earlier the DataKrash had already killed the Old NET.

Who Did It

Arasaka blamed terrorists led by Johnny Silverhand; President Kress blamed Arasaka for twenty-four years. In 2045 Trace Santiago's exposé showed it was Militech: a nomad on the raid team inside the tower watched its leader walk down a stairwell with a heavy suitcase, and the tower went up a minute or two after the extraction AV lifted off. Nobody believed it until after the Purge, when the re-released story stuck and the hearings that followed ended Kress's presidency in 2053.
